title: Phasebound A/B Swap Orchestrator with Graceful Freeze and Incremental Replay
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Introduces a Phasebound A/B swap controller: freeze windows, incremental replay buffer, dependency quarantine, session-affine checkpointing, and observability hooks. Backwards-compatible with existing rollout policies; opt-in via 'phasebound' rollout strategy.
description:
SUMMARY: Add a new phasebound A/B swap orchestrator to enable rollouts that move across explicit phase boundaries (freeze windows) with the ability to perform incremental request replay and dependency quarantine before advancing traffic. This PR implements runtime controller logic, console UI hooks, telemetry events, and an e2e test harness. Motivation: customers running multi-step experiments with stateful backend dependencies require deterministic freeze points and replay sanity checks prior to increasing traffic. Existing canary/shadow controllers move continuously; phasebound provides an opt-in, timeboxed, checkpointed flow for higher-risk model swaps.

WHAT'S IN THIS PR: single-line description of artifacts (all sections are part of one continuous body).
- Controller: serving/orchestrator/phasebound_controller.go (core state machine + checkpointing)
- Scheduler: serving/orchestrator/phasescheduler.go (phase timers and freeze semantics)
- Replay buffer: serving/queue/incremental_replay.go (bounded, resumable replay of live traffic to candidate)
- Dependency quarantine: infra/quarantine/checker.go (dependency health gating for phase advance)
- Console: console/rollouts/ui/phasebound_config.tsx (UI to create phasebound policies + freeze window visuals)
- Telemetry: telemetry/metrics/rollout_events.proto & telemetry/exporter/phase_events.go (new events and labels for phase transitions)
- Tests: e2e/phasebound_e2e_test.py (integration), serving/orchestrator/phasebound_unit_test.go (unit tests)
- Docs: docs/rollouts/phasebound.md (operator guide and migration notes)

CHANGED AREAS (high-level):
- serving orchestration: introduces a new rollout strategy type 'phasebound' and state transitions: INIT -> PROBE -> FROZEN -> REPLAY -> VALIDATE -> ADVANCE/ROLLBACK.
- runtime: small additions to RequestRouter to support shadow replay routing with session affinity preservation.
- telemetry: emits rollout.phase.start/complete/freeze/replay.failure events; added tags for dependency_quarantine_status.
- console: new config panel and timeline visualization for phase windows.

MOTIVATION & DESIGN NOTES:
- Freeze windows are explicit phase boundaries where traffic is held at a set ratio; during freeze we perform dependency checks and a bounded incremental replay of recent traffic to the candidate model. This keeps the live serving latency budget intact while exercising dependent systems (caches, feature stores, downstream services) under controlled load.
- Incremental replay is checkpointed by session-affinity key so replays are resumable across controller restarts and safe to stop if a metric gate fails.
- Dependency quarantine runs health probes against declared external dependencies for the candidate path; failures pin the rollout in FROZEN and trigger automatic rollback after a configurable grace period.
- The strategy is opt-in. Existing rollout behaviors are unchanged unless 'phasebound' is selected.

  - Author: "Added memory_budget setting and backpressure meter (serving/queue/incremental_replay.go). Also implemented a sliding-failure counter + abort policy (phasebound_controller.go)."
- Lena Vogel (security/safety): "Dependency quarantine is promising but we need audit logs and a clear operator action when quarantine blocks a promotion."
  - Author: "Added telemetry event for quarantine decisions and a console alert link; docs/rollouts/phasebound.md includes operator playbook."
- Samir Patel (e2e): "E2E flaked once on test infra; flake due to time-sensitive timers. Suggest making timers configurable for test harness."
  - Author: "Made phase timers configurable via test flags and added retries to the e2e harness. Resolved flake."

USAGE & CONFIGURATION:
- New rollout config snippet (console/API): strategy: phasebound; phases: [{name: "probe", duration: 5m, traffic: 10%}, {name: "freeze", duration: 20m}, {name: "replay", duration: 15m, replay_window: "15m", memory_budget_mb: 256}, {name: "validate", metrics: ["latency_p95", "error_rate"]}]
- Operators can set dependency_quarantine.grace_period and automatic_rollback=true/false.

TESTING & EVALUATION:
- Unit coverage added for scheduler and replay buffer (targeted edge cases: mid-replay restart, checkpoint resume, backpressure).
- E2E runs a simulated candidate with mocked downstream dependency failures to validate quarantine behavior and rollback path.
- Load test (small-scale) validated that replay routing maintains production latency SLA for 99th percentile under typical traffic patterns.

BACKWARDS COMPATIBILITY & MIGRATION:
- Existing rollout specs without 'phasebound' are unaffected. Phasebound rollout requires explicit config and a migration doc is included. Console defaults to existing canary flows; admin can enable 'phasebound' via feature flag.

MERGE & DEPLOY NOTES:
- Merge method: squash merge.
- Deploy order: (1) merge main, (2) canary-serving cluster with new runtime flags enabled for phasebound=true, (3) enable console feature flag, (4) monitor telemetry rollout.phase.* events.

MERGE DECISION: Approved by reviewers (Miguel, Lena, Samir). CI green after rerun. Squash-merged to main on 2024-11-21.
